svg.text: Inside the web container: how a request travels through app/main.py, which router, template folder, API router, service and models make up each module, and the shared layers underneath. System-level picture: docs/architecture.svg
@app.middleware("http"); the last one registered runs first
Result on request.state: module_flags, permissions, locale, region, club_name, nav_counts
~130 call sites; one shared Jinja env (app/templating.py)
MODULE MAP (one row per module; every router lives in app/routers/, templates in app/templates/)
Opt-in: opens a public endpoint, stores outbound credentials or handles money
Module off → require_module() raises 404 for every route of its router; nav entry hidden via request.state.module_flags
One shared Jinja2Templates instance for all routers
· content · extra_scripts; every page extends it
auth.py: password hashing, signed session cookie,
provider_registry.py: one active provider per kind
get_db() dependency, one session per request
services/*: framework-free business rules shared by
enum columns store the member NAME, uppercase
schemas.py: Pydantic models for the REST API
ClubSetting: key/value for settings, flags, providers
Scheduled cloud backup: checks every 15 min
Each loop catches its own errors and does nothing
WEBSITE: WordPress, Parcella plugin, Markdown folder
Design rationale: docs/ADR/ · per-module details: docs/module-*.md · module checklist: docs/README.md
